newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aristocrat says 1st qtr on target.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aristocrat says 1st qtr on target.

text.p: Gaming machine maker Aristocrat Leisure Ltd said on Thursday its first quarter result was in line with budget.
"We were broadly in line with budget, and that is based on the prospectus forecast," chairman Allan McDonald told reporters during the annual general meeting.
However, McDonald would not provide any details on the first quarter results.

McDonald earlier told meeting the company remained confident of achieving its profit forecast for the year to June 30, 1997 contained in its prospectus, based on the first quarter resutls and present trading trends.
Aristocrat forecast earnings before tax and abnormals of A$32.8 million for the 1996/97 year.
It reported an operating profit of A$24.08 million in 1995/96, above the prospectus forecast of A$23.7 million.
Aristocrat listed on the Australian Stock Exchange in July 1996. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
